text_block_list.text: A few days after the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yo, coming in～.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... Stego-senpai and her Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yo. Looks like you're in good spirits.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Here are some momiji manju as a souvenir.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you. ...However—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the get-well gifts are piling up 
into a mountain. No way I can eat all 
this.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Spe-chan is coming over later, so I 
thought we could eat it together then.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That sounds nice. ...You're truly loved, 
Suzuka—

...Right after the Tenno Sho (Autumn), it 
was discovered that Silence Suzuka had 
suffered an injury.

Through the media, fans learned that 
Silence Suzuka would be forced to take a 
hiatus. While many were saddened—

Relief echoed across the public that her 
career as a racing Umamusume was spared 
from a major, devastating injury...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like my return will be next 
year. They told me June at the earliest.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Whew, glad it didn't end up being worse. 
Well, don't rush it, just take your time 
healing up.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is my intention. ...Because I 
want to run again, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
..................The other day's Tenno 
Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I had every intention of surpassing my own 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I was aiming for a serene, light-filled 
landscape untouched by anyone. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"That day, Senpai's running sounded so 
loud and felt so close."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"The sensation of being pulled forward and 
accelerating suddenly vanished—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The sound of my own heartbeat became 
crystal clear... and the heat of the 
racetrack reached me...—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Right after the run finished, I 
couldn't sort through my feelings and was 
completely lost.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Still, now I understand. ...The sound of 
that heartbeat and the heat I felt that 
day were so very comforting.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel like when I make my comeback, 
I'll be able to run even better than 
before. So—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: For racing with me... on that day.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: That's my line.

After visiting Silence Suzuka, Stay Gold 
and I found ourselves walking without a 
word to a spot with a clear view of the 
evening sky—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—...I'm only saying this because it's 
already over, but.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"If things went according to the 
'memories'... Suzuka wouldn't have been 
able to run anymore after that last race."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
“Yet it didn't turn out that way. ...And 
it probably never will.”
choice_data_list: Is it because you ran with Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? Or perhaps everything was 
different from much earlier on.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, but it's way too late for that 
now.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Running the Satsuki Sho, and running 
the Japan Derby too."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Choosing to run in the Autumn Tenno Sho 
instead of the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to those "memories," I'm the 
most wildly temperamental one making a 
mess of them.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"It's not just 'Things might not go the 
way the "memories" said.' There was never 
any way they would in the first place."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
When I think about that, haha— Maybe I 
wasn't as prepared as I thought either.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere in my heart... I was still 
laying down a path called "memories."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
However... I completely surpassed all of 
that in the previous Tenno Sho (Autumn).
choice_data_list: ...Could the sensation I felt that day be—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's a sign that we've ventured into 
uncharted territory.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"From here on out... it's gonna get so 
much more absurd that everything up until 
now will seem cute by comparison."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ――――I'm so excited.

Curiosity glimmers deep within her eyes. 
As I gaze into them, a certain question 
bubbles up—
choice_data_list:
Stay Gold, what do you want to do from now 
on?

text_block_list.text:
Now that I've strayed from the path paved 
by "memories," it must be time to decide. 
The destination of my new journey.

And surely, that place must be where her 
desired "new gold" lies, or perhaps the 
gold itself.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. If we are to tread this 
untrodden path—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Maybe aiming for the thing most impossible 
according to those "memories" wouldn't be 
so bad.
choice_data_list: The most impossible thing of all—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...My 'memories' are adorned with many 
'brilliant things.'"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
They were always running ahead of me... 
generating fervor... shaping an era—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely because so much of it is burned 
into my mind, those 'memories' speak to 
me—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Stay Gold was never the center of the 
era," they said.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—Then there's only one thing left to do, 
right?

"‘So go ahead and say it,’ she seemed to 
say. Her eyes were fixed on me. I answered 
that expectation without hesitation."
choice_data_list:
...Let's aim for the center of this new 
era together.

...Aim for the center of the era together 
with me.

text_block_list.text:
It is not merely about growing stronger. 
It is not merely about standing at the 
peak.

That Stay Gold shaped this era. That she 
was the true centerpiece. I will forge 
hoofprints that will be spoken of in such 
regard.
choice_data_list: That's our journey from here on out...!
That's our journey from here on out...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, as expected, this is great.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Traveling with you is truly 
fascinating...!
—That night.

In a meeting to decide specific target 
races in order to aim for the center of 
the era—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"If we're gonna run, we might as well 
aggressively go for the win in races we 
have strong ties to."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Just like with the Tenno Sho (Autumn) the 
other day. It's far more entertaining to 
dramatically overturn everyone's 
'memories.'"
choice_data_list: In that case, the specific races would be—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring), the Takarazuka 
Kinen, the Tenno Sho (Autumn), and the 
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If you ask me, this is definitely the 
spot. ...The one I can never forget.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? How will you journey to 
reach the center of this era?

...While running the races she proposed, I 
also have races in mind that could further 
bolster my credibility as the center of 
this era.
choice_data_list:
...How about being the first in history to 
win it?

text_block_list.text:
"Achieving a feat no one else has 
accomplished— that, to me, is undeniable 
proof of having forged an era of one's 
own."
choice_data_list:
For example, international GIs in Hong 
Kong!

text_block_list.text:
No Japanese Umamusume has ever won an 
international GⅠ held in Hong Kong in 
December...

"In terms of timing and race conditions, 
this should definitely be added to our 
upcoming target races...!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Sounds good.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Then let's set our sights on Hong Kong. 
There, we'll settle the final score... and 
bring it all to an end.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
For now, first up is next year's Tenno Sho 
(Spring), I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I can hardly wait.

...An untrodden path, yet with a pounding 
heart, I shall walk it with her.

The Tenno Sho (Spring). Just what awaits 
there—
